title: Grateful Dead Live at Ice Stadium on 1990-10-13
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100)

ai_review.summary: Excellent 24‑bit Charlie Miller soundboard captures a rare, great Swedish show.
ai_review.review: This recording documents the Dead’s sole concert in Sweden and delivers it with a magnificent 24‑bit Charlie Miller soundboard that reviewers describe as crystal‑clear. The performance is praised as a “great little show,” making it a memorable snapshot despite the limited set information.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review highlights both an outstanding soundboard recording and a highly enjoyable performance, but confidence is low due to the limited number of reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 24‑bit Charlie Miller soundboard praised as magnificent; clear, detailed mix with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Brief but memorable show; reviewers note it as a great little performance and the rarity of the Swedish gig adds to its appeal.
